subject.title: feat(android): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw maintain Android-native PNG copy/save actions for transcript widgets as the cross-platform export feature is completed?
rationale: The branch adds a new maintained Android interaction and has a protected maintainer label; the merged web counterpart supports the product direction, but only a responsible human can confirm Android scope and acceptance criteria.

options.title: Sponsor Android parity
options.body: Keep this Android-native implementation, require visible device proof and green native Android validation, then review it for merge.

options.title: Defer Android export
options.body: Leave the existing Android transcript interaction unchanged and close or narrow this feature until Android product priority is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Android parity
recommendation.body: Keep this Android-native implementation, require visible device proof and green native Android validation, then review it for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed widget-export work provides the clearest available context for the cross-platform feature direction.
